title: Use direct Dynkin drift rather than an unproved mixing time
statement: For W(a)=(a+N^(3/4))^(-3) with cemetery value zero, the acquired audit checks Q_N W<=-c0 W in three regions including both endpoints. Finite-state stopped Dynkin yields sup_a E_a tau_kill<=C N^(-9/4), so each Green diagonal is no larger. The added killing 6 therefore loses only 1+O(N^(-9/4)); combined with the forest comparison it improves the shifted two-sided polynomial exponent from the older D=16 to D=4. Restoring the physical generator divides this time by (B)_4. No conservative gap/mixing estimate or general-degree extension follows.
